Task L11: Normalize job URLs before deduplication

Implement canonical_url(url). Accept only http or https URLs. Lowercase scheme and host; remove fragment; remove a single trailing slash from non-root paths; preserve query exactly. Reject non-strings, missing host, and other schemes with ValueError. The restricted adapter has no URL library: implement it with string operations.

def canonical_url(url):
    # Validate input is a string
    if not isinstance(url, str):
        raise ValueError("URL must be a string")
    
    # Split URL into components
    parts = url.split('://', 1)
    if len(parts) != 2:
        raise ValueError("URL must contain a scheme (http or https)")
    
    scheme, rest = parts
    if scheme.lower() not in ('http', 'https'):
        raise ValueError("Only http or https schemes are allowed")
    
    # Lowercase scheme
    scheme = scheme.lower()
    
    # Split host and path/query/fragment
    remaining_parts = rest.split('#', 1)
    if len(remaining_parts) > 1:
        rest = remaining_parts[0]  # Remove fragment
    
    # Split host and the rest (path/query)
    host_path_query = remaining_parts[0].split('/', 1)
    host = host_path_query[0]
    
    if not host:
        raise ValueError("URL must contain a valid host")
    
    # Lowercase host
    host = host.lower()
    
    # Reconstruct path/query part
    path_query = host_path_query[1] if len(host_path_query) > 1 else ''
    
    # Remove trailing slash from non-root paths
    if path_query and path_query.startswith('/'):
        path_parts = path_query.split('?', 1)
        path = path_parts[0]
        query = path_parts[1] if len(path_parts) > 1 else ''
        
        if path and path.endswith('/') and not path.endswith('//'):
            path = path[:-1]
        
        path_query = path + ('?' + query if query else '')
    
    # Rebuild the URL
    canonical_url = f"{scheme}://{host}" + (f"{path_query}" if path_query else '')
    
    return canonical_url

import urls
import json

# Test cases for canonical_url

def test_canonical_url():
    # Test valid URLs
    assert urls.canonical_url("HTTP://EXAMPLE.COM/path#fragment") == "http://example.com/path"
    assert urls.canonical_url("HTTPS://EXAMPLE.COM/path/") == "https://example.com/path"
    assert urls.canonical_url("https://EXAMPLE.COM/path?query=value") == "https://example.com/path?query=value"
    assert urls.canonical_url("http://EXAMPLE.COM/") == "http://example.com/"
    assert urls.canonical_url("https://EXAMPLE.COM:8080/path") == "https://example.com:8080/path"
    
    # Test edge cases
    assert urls.canonical_url("http://EXAMPLE.COM/path//extra//slash") == "http://example.com/path//extra//slash"
    assert urls.canonical_url("http://EXAMPLE.COM/path/with/trailing/") == "http://example.com/path/with/trailing"
    
    # Test invalid URLs
    try:
        urls.canonical_url("ftp://example.com")
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for unsupported scheme"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        urls.canonical_url("example.com")
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for missing scheme"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        urls.canonical_url(123)
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for non-string input"
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    try:
        urls.canonical_url("http://")
        assert False, "Should raise ValueError for missing host"
    except ValueError:
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_canonical_url()
    print("All tests passed!")
